##### Project General Facts

Azure Oceanfront Villas is a limited collection of 19 four- and five-bedroom villas developed by DarGlobal, with interiors designed in collaboration with Fendi Casa. The villas are arranged over a ground, first and second floor. Set on an elevated clifftop position within Aida, the collection is positioned as an exclusive, low-density residential offering with panoramic sea views forming part of its design intent.

Each villa includes a private garden, an expansive terrace and an infinity pool overlooking the sea. Within Aida, residents also have access to a wider range of community amenities, including the Trump International Hotel and Trump International Golf Clubhouse, an 18-hole Trump Championship Golf Course, a wellness centre and fitness centre, swimming pools, children's splash areas, landscaped parks, hiking and mountain-bike trails, running trails, viewing decks, promenades, and plazas with cafés and restaurants.

Interiors are designed by Fendi Casa, drawing on a material palette of ribbed marble, cast glass, pequin wood and rhombus motifs, aged bronze metal, wood veneer and precious-stone accents, expressed through clean lines, harmonious proportions and a neutral, tactile palette of fine woods, sumptuous textiles and bespoke cabinetry and lighting. The furniture and styling shown reflect the Fendi Casa interior concept for illustrative purposes, and the villas are delivered unfurnished.


##### Location description and benefits

Muscat is the capital city of Oman, set between rugged mountains and the calm waters of the Arabian Sea. The city is known for its unique character, where traditional Arabian architecture blends with modern urban development. Low-rise buildings, white facades, and carefully preserved heritage areas create a clean and harmonious cityscape, while landmarks such as Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque and the Royal Opera House reflect the cultural identity and elegance of the capital.

The lifestyle in Muscat is calm and comfort, offering a balance between city convenience and natural surroundings. Residents enjoy access to beaches, scenic coastal roads, and green parks, along with shopping malls, international schools, and healthcare facilities. Popular areas like Al Mouj Muscat and Qurum provide a mix of residential, leisure, and retail options, making the city suitable for both families and professionals.

Muscat continues to grow as an attractive destination for living and investment, supported by stable infrastructure and a high quality of life. The city offers a range of residential options, from beachfront apartments to private villas, many designed with spacious layouts and modern finishes. With its safety, cultural richness, and relaxed pace of life, Muscat stands out as one of the most desirable locations in the Gulf region.
